name: JD Health International Inc.
summary: JD Health International Inc., functioning as an investment holding entity, runs an expansive digital healthcare platform across the People's Republic of China. The company supplies a diverse range of pharmaceutical and wellness products, such as over-the-counter and prescription medications, medical devices, and health supplements. These goods are distributed through both direct sales and an extensive online retail pharmacy network. Beyond product offerings, its comprehensive service suite includes virtual medical consultations, patient referrals to hospitals and doctors, health screening programs, genetic testing, and beauty care services. Additionally, it develops intelligent healthcare and wellness management solutions, alongside providing technical support and advertising services. The platform also facilitates access to various medical provisions, including general health examinations, cosmetic medical procedures, vaccination bookings, dental treatments, and nucleic acid testing. Incorporated in 2018 and headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China, JD Health International Inc. is a subsidiary of JD Jiankang Limited.
